meta.transmission: 5-speed TorqueFlite (45RFE/545RFE) 2009-2012; 8-speed TorqueFlite 2013-2024: 845RE/8HP45 (V6 3.6L), 8HP70 (Hemi 5.7L V8 and EcoDiesel 3.0L V6)

shiftLock.slot:
5-SPEED (2009-2012 DS, floor console shifter): Small cap beside the gear selector gate on the console. Pry cap off with flathead screwdriver. Insert screwdriver into slot to depress shift interlock. Press brake and move selector to N. NOTE: 2013+ DS trucks transitioned to 8-speed with under-dash release — see above.

8-SPEED (2013+ DS / ALL DT / TRX / CLASSIC): Manual Park Release under the dash. Panel is LEFT of steering column, ABOVE the parking brake release handle. Pry off small plastic cover with flathead screwdriver. Inside: push the locking tab to the RIGHT with a screwdriver, then pull the orange tether strap REARWARD (toward driver seat) until it clicks locked. Vehicle is now in neutral. TC must be in 2WD/2H — see TC note below.
steps: Turn ignition to ON.
Locate the shift lock override slot — Cap at side of console shifter base.
Insert a thin key or flathead into the slot.
Press firmly and hold.
Press the brake pedal.
Move the TorqueFlite selector to Neutral.
Apply parking brake.
Battery under hood, driver side — connect jump pack directly.
Once 12V restored: press brake and shift to N normally (if 5-spd console shifter).
8-SPEED / DEAD BATTERY: pry off panel LEFT of steering column above park brake release. Push locking tab RIGHT, pull orange strap REARWARD until it clicks. Truck is now in N.
TRANSFER CASE: must be in 2WD/2H before road towing. Electronic TC: with engine running, shift TC to 2H. Manual TC: floor lever to 2H. IF BATTERY DEAD: jump first — shift TC requires power.
RWD: lift from rear. 4WD: flatbed strongly preferred.

tow.method: RWD/2WD: lift from rear — rear (drive) wheels in the air. 4WD: transfer case to 2H first, then lift from rear — rear (drive) wheels in the air. Wheel-lift max: 35 mph, 50 miles — flatbed preferred for longer distances.
notes: MANUAL TRANSFER CASE (floor lever): Vehicle must be STOPPED to shift. If lever is stiff, rock vehicle slightly in neutral while applying firm pressure.
ELECTRONIC TRANSFER CASE: Requires 12V power to shift. If battery is dead, jump the battery FIRST, then shift TC to 2WD before disconnecting.
DEAD BATTERY FALLBACK: If TC cannot be shifted to 2WD, USE FLATBED. Do NOT tow with TC in 4WD/4H/4L — will destroy transfer case and driveline.
4WD DOLLY FALLBACK: If transfer case CANNOT be shifted to 2WD (dead battery, mechanical failure), either use flatbed OR wheel-lift with dollies on the opposite axle.

alerts.notes: 4WD: transfer case MUST be in 2H before towing on road.

meta.transmission: 8-speed TorqueFlite automatic: 850RE (V6 3.6L), 8HP75 (Hemi 5.7L V8 2019-2024, returned 2026). 2025+: 3.0L Hurricane I6 SO (420 hp) or HO (540 hp) — same 8-speed TorqueFlite (8HP75). eTorque is a mild hybrid belt-starter system — not a separate transmission.

Apply parking brake.
Battery under hood — connect jump pack directly.
Once 12V restored: press brake and turn electronic dial/selector to N normally.

RWD: lift from rear. 4WD: flatbed strongly preferred.

tow.method: RWD/2WD: lift from rear — rear (drive) wheels in the air. 4WD: transfer case to 2H first, then lift from rear — rear (drive) wheels in the air. Wheel-lift max: 35 mph, 50 miles — flatbed preferred for longer distances.
notes: HYBRID/PHEV: Use 12V auxiliary battery ONLY for jumping. NEVER access the high-voltage battery pack.

alerts.notes: eTorque mild hybrid: same 12V procedure. eTorque mild hybrid (2019+): 12V auxiliary under hood. Same jump procedure as standard.

issues.title: eTorque Mild Hybrid — Not Full Hybrid
issues.detail: The eTorque system is a 48V mild hybrid assist. Despite having a small lithium battery, this is NOT a full hybrid. The 12V battery under the hood is used for jumping normally. The eTorque battery is not accessible for jumping and is managed separately by the vehicle.

issues.title: Full-Time AWD — No 2WD Mode
issues.detail: Unlike standard Ram 1500 4WD models, the RHO uses a BorgWarner 48-13 full-time active transfer case with NO 2WD option. The front axle cannot be disengaged. This means wheel-lift towing (rear wheels up) will still drag the front driveline. FLATBED ONLY.

issues.title: Active Suspension — Set to Normal Before Towing
issues.detail: The RHO has active Bilstein shocks and may be in a raised off-road height setting. Use the touchscreen or drive mode selector to lower the truck to Normal or Entry height before loading onto a flatbed, if the vehicle has power.

issues.title: Known Issue: 12V Battery Drain
issues.detail: 2025-2026 DT trucks (including RHO) have a known issue with 12V battery drain, often triggered by key fob proximity. TSB 08-380-25 addresses this with a BCM software reflash. Dead batteries are common on these trucks.

issues.title: Manual Transfer Case Lever May Be Stiff
issues.detail: The NV271 manual transfer case floor lever on older HD Rams can be extremely stiff, especially if the vehicle has been in 4WD for extended periods. Rock the vehicle gently in neutral while applying firm pressure to the lever. Do not force — damage to the TC shift fork can occur.

issues.title: Very Heavy Vehicle — Equipment Ratings Critical
issues.detail: Ram 2500/3500 curb weight ranges from 6,400–7,200 lbs. A fully loaded 3500 dually can exceed 14,000 lbs GVWR. Verify all wheel-lift and flatbed equipment is rated appropriately. Standard equipment is often under-rated for these trucks.

Pry cap off, insert screwdriver to depress shift interlock solenoid. Press brake and move lever to N. 9-SPEED 948TE (2022+): floor-mounted selector lever with electronic parking brake. Confirm via owner's manual — procedure changed with 2022 update.

issues.title: 62TE 6-Speed (2014-2021) — Rollaway Recall
issues.detail: 2019-2021 ProMasters with 62TE were recalled for transmission shifter cable separation and premature clutch retainer failure. Confirm recall was addressed before towing. Park pawl may not engage properly.

issues.title: 948TE 9-Speed (2022+) — Top Gears Locked Out
issues.detail: The 2022+ ProMaster uses a 948TE 9-speed but 8th and 9th gears are software-locked due to the van's weight and gearing. Effectively operates as a 7-speed. Same shift-to-neutral procedure as 62TE — floor-mounted shifter.

issues.title: PHEV Series Hybrid — Not Traditional Hybrid
issues.detail: The 1500 REV uses a series hybrid architecture. The 3.6L Pentastar V6 acts only as an onboard generator — it has NO mechanical connection to the wheels. All drive power comes from electric motors. Towing procedures are the same as a BEV: flatbed only, 12V auxiliary for jumping.

issues.title: All-Electric BEV Version Delayed
issues.detail: The original all-electric Ram 1500 REV (BEV) has been delayed to summer 2027 at earliest. The production vehicle launching as 2026 REV is the Ramcharger plug-in hybrid with range extender.

issues.title: Manual Transfer Case Lever May Be Stiff
issues.detail: The NV271 manual transfer case floor lever can be extremely stiff, especially after extended 4WD use. Rock the vehicle gently in neutral while applying firm pressure. Do not force — damage to the TC shift fork can occur.

issues.title: Very Heavy Vehicle — Equipment Ratings Critical

issues.title: No Mechanical Neutral Override
issues.detail: The ProMaster EV has no mechanical override to shift to Neutral without 12V power. If the 12V auxiliary battery is completely dead and cannot be jumped, the vehicle must be winched onto a flatbed.

issues.title: High Voltage Battery Safety
issues.detail: The HV battery is located under the floor. NEVER touch orange or yellow HV cables. If the vehicle has been in a collision or flood, maintain safe distance from HV components and wait for qualified EV technicians.
